10
Ɔbɔfoɔ no ne Nwoma ketewa no
1 # Adi 5.2; 4.3 Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ hoɔdenfoɔ bi sɛ ɔfiri soro reba fam, na ɔfira mununkum, na nyankontɔn wɔ ne tiri so, na n’anim te sɛ owia, na ne nan te sɛ ogya fadum. 2#Adi 5.1 Na ɔkura nwoma ketewa bi a emu abue wɔ ne nsa mu, na ɔde ne nan nifa sii po so, na ɔde benkum sii asase so. 3#Yer 25.30; Hos 11.10; Amos 1.2 Na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛdeɛ gyata bobɔ mu. Na ɔteaa mu no, aprannaa nson no de wɔn nne kasae. 4#Dan 8.26; 12.4; 12.9 Na aprannaa nson no kasaeɛ no, anka mereyɛ matwerɛ. Na metee sɛ ɛnne bi firi soro reka kyerɛ me sɛ: Sɔ deɛ aprannaa nson no aka no ano, na ntwerɛ!
5Na ɔbɔfoɔ a mehunuu no sɛ ɔgyina po ne asase soɔ no
maa ne nsa so kyerɛɛ soro.
6 # Dan 12.7; Adi 6.11 Na ɔkaa deɛ ɔte ase daa daa,
a ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu ne asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu, ne ɛpo ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu no ho ntam sɛ: Berɛ bi nni hɔ bio, 7#Adi 11.15; 17.17; Aso 3.21 na mmom nna a ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no bɛhyɛne n’abɛn no, na Onyankopɔn ahuntasɛm no aba mu, sɛdeɛ ɔkaa ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ ne nkoa, adiyifoɔ no.
Ɔbɔfoɔ no nwoma
8 # Adi 10.2, 4 Na ɛnne a mete firii soro no ne me kasaa bio sɛ: Kɔ kɔgye nwoma ketewa a wɔabue mu no ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔgyina asase ne po soɔ no nsam. 9#Hes 3.1-3 Na mekɔɔ ɔbɔfoɔ no nkyɛn mekɔka mekyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa nwoma ketewa no mma me. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Gye mene, na ɛbɛyɛ nwononwono wo yam, na w’anomu deɛ, ɛbɛyɛ fremfrem sɛ ɛwoɔ. 10Na megyee nwoma ketewa no firii ɔbɔfoɔ no nsa mu memeneeɛ, na ɛyɛɛ fremfrem wɔ m’anomu sɛ ɛwoɔ, na mewiee die no, ɛyɛɛ nwononwono wɔ me yam. 11Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ woka nkurɔfoɔ ne aman ne ɔkasa ne ahemfo bebree ho adiyisɛm bio.

pageProps.chapterText:
Na mehunuu ɔbɔfoɔ foforɔ hoɔdenfoɔ bi sɛ ɔfiri soro reba fam, na ɔfira mununkum, na nyankontɔn wɔ ne tiri so, na n’anim te sɛ owia, na ne nan te sɛ ogya fadum. Na ɔkura nwoma ketewa bi a emu abue wɔ ne nsa mu, na ɔde ne nan nifa sii po so, na ɔde benkum sii asase so. Na ɔde nne kɛseɛ teaa mu sɛdeɛ gyata bobɔ mu. Na ɔteaa mu no, aprannaa nson no de wɔn nne kasae. Na aprannaa nson no kasaeɛ no, anka mereyɛ matwerɛ. Na metee sɛ ɛnne bi firi soro reka kyerɛ me sɛ: Sɔ deɛ aprannaa nson no aka no ano, na ntwerɛ!
Na ɔbɔfoɔ a mehunuu no sɛ ɔgyina po ne asase soɔ no
maa ne nsa so kyerɛɛ soro.
Na ɔkaa deɛ ɔte ase daa daa,
a ɔbɔɔ ɔsoro ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu ne asase ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu, ne ɛpo ne deɛ ɛwɔ mu no ho ntam sɛ: Berɛ bi nni hɔ bio, na mmom nna a ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔtɔ so nson no bɛhyɛne n’abɛn no, na Onyankopɔn ahuntasɛm no aba mu, sɛdeɛ ɔkaa ho asɛmpa kyerɛɛ ne nkoa, adiyifoɔ no.

Na ɛnne a mete firii soro no ne me kasaa bio sɛ: Kɔ kɔgye nwoma ketewa a wɔabue mu no ɔbɔfoɔ a ɔgyina asase ne po soɔ no nsam. Na mekɔɔ ɔbɔfoɔ no nkyɛn mekɔka mekyerɛɛ no sɛ ɔmfa nwoma ketewa no mma me. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Gye mene, na ɛbɛyɛ nwononwono wo yam, na w’anomu deɛ, ɛbɛyɛ fremfrem sɛ ɛwoɔ. Na megyee nwoma ketewa no firii ɔbɔfoɔ no nsa mu memeneeɛ, na ɛyɛɛ fremfrem wɔ m’anomu sɛ ɛwoɔ, na mewiee die no, ɛyɛɛ nwononwono wɔ me yam. Na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Ɛsɛ sɛ woka nkurɔfoɔ ne aman ne ɔkasa ne ahemfo bebree ho adiyisɛm bio.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
